newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX BRENT RANGEBOUND IN A LACKLUSTRE MARKET.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX BRENT RANGEBOUND IN A LACKLUSTRE MARKET.

text.p: September Brent futures remained untraded late Thursday, with levels still rangebound in the absence of any headline news.
September Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.96/$19.04 per barrel, after London ended 14 cents higher at $18.99 on Wednesday.
October Brent on SIMEX last traded at $19.12, four cents weaker than London close of $19.16.
Brokers expected prices to rise further, as the market was moving in the same upward parallel seen in the period between July 21 to Aug 7, after hitting low levels on Friday.
London IPE opened stronger on Thursday, and was last traded at $19.07 for September.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded $20.16, down four cents from New York's $20.19.
